strings.tut_r0_a: The hallway goes on longer than the school does. Rooms branch off it, some lit, some not. The exit at the far end is sealed: it opens when every fight down here is won.
strings.tut_r1_a: Up top is the turn order. Faster things go first. Right now, it's you.
strings.tut_r1_b: Every turn you get 2 Actions. Moving is one. Walk next to that slip of paper.
strings.tut_r1_hint: Click a blue tile to move there. That's one Action.
strings.tut_r1_c: And on top of your 2 Actions you get 1 Quick. Strike is a Quick. Hit it. With your... hands.
strings.tut_r1_hint2: Press Strike (S) and click the slip next to you.
strings.tut_r1_kelly: Kelly: "You punched a piece of paper. Great. We're saved."
strings.tut_r2_a: See the red tiles? That's what it's about to do. It's slow. It's obvious. It's going to hurt.
strings.tut_r2_b: Step out of the red before its turn.
strings.tut_r2_hint: Move to any tile that isn't red.
strings.tut_r2_c: Now that you're not standing in the bad part, hit it back.
strings.tut_r2_mock: You stood in the red. On purpose? Bold. The floor down here is kind tonight; it won't be later.
strings.tut_r3_kelly: Kelly: "Why is it looking at ME? Why is it always looking at me?"
strings.tut_r3_a: This one doesn't aim at tiles. It aims at you. The icon over its head says so. Running won't help if it can reach you.
strings.tut_r3_b: Guard is a Quick too. It soaks the hit. Use it before its turn.
strings.tut_r4_a: Your hand: 3 cards, fresh every turn. Unplayed cards go to the discard pile when you end your turn.
strings.tut_r4_b: Hover a card before you play it. The tiles light up: range, area, damage.
strings.tut_r4_hint: Move the mouse over a card in your hand.
strings.tut_r4_c: Spells cost MP. MP doesn't come back tonight. Budget.
strings.tut_r4_d: Strike can't reach across that gap. A Bolt can.
strings.tut_r4_e: Like a card too much to lose it? Hold costs an Action and keeps one card for next turn.
strings.tut_r5_a: Every creature down here is weak to something and stubborn about something else. The icons on them say which.
strings.tut_r5_kelly: Kelly: "Let me get the shiny one. Light. I've got light. Apparently."
strings.tut_r5_b: Hit the soft one with what it hates. Let your friends cover what you can't.
strings.tut_r6_a: Walls block sight. Low walls and crates give cover: hits that come across them deal half.
strings.tut_r6_b: Cover only works from the front. Go around it and you're flanking: no cover at all.
strings.tut_r6_c: Or hide behind your own cover when it aims at you. Hiding counts as a strategy. Ask any teenager.
strings.tut_r6_hint: Move next to a low wall so it sits between you and the sniper, or walk around it.
strings.tut_rest_a: A campfire, burning in a trophy case. Resting here brings your HP and MP all the way back. There's a chest too.
strings.tut_r7_kelly: Kelly shoves the air with both hands. A Force push. The plate skids. "Did I do that? I did that."
strings.tut_r7_a: Burning tiles hurt whoever stands on them. Pushing something into fire, a wall or another creature hurts it more.
strings.tut_r7_b: One plate's attack is aimed where the other one stands. Help them help you.
strings.tut_r8_a: The bull is charging up. Next turn it runs the whole line. Kelly is in the way.
strings.tut_r8_b: Dash is a quick card: it doesn't use an Action. Play it before you move and that move goes further.
strings.tut_r8_c: Light cancels a charge. Kelly has some. Or get there first.
strings.tut_r9_a: Your hand is all wrong for this one. It shrugs off everything you brought. So stop reading the script.
strings.tut_r9_b: The Vector Wheel: pick Vectors, a shape and a size, burn a card as fuel. The first one always works. After that, Instability is real.
strings.tut_r9_c: Prepared magic is a speech. Improvising is yelling.
strings.tut_r10_a: Hold T: the threat view shades every tile by how much it hurts to stand there.
strings.tut_r10_b: The moth heals the others. The bull charges in lines. The gremlins are just loud. Pick an order.
strings.tut_r10_shortcut: You skipped the hot floor. Pushing things into fire or into each other's attacks works here too.
strings.tut_skip_text: The Narrator's Journal remembers this floor. Skip the lessons? The fights stay; the speeches go.
strings.tut_exit: The exit door unseals with a sound like a locker slamming in reverse. Every fight won. The counter hits 0.

strings.forge.upgrade_help: Spend Scraps to upgrade a card to its + version.
strings.forge.riders_help: Spend Scraps to add a rider. Each extra rider on a card costs more, and riders raise the card's MP cost.
